Bootstrap Icons v1.13.1
======================

Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.13.1
Website: https://icons.getbootstrap.com/
License: MIT; see LICENSE (also embedded in chat.exe as resource 102).

The upstream WOFF font and selected SVG originals are retained here. The TTF
is generated from that WOFF using `node convert-font.cjs`. Normal builds use
the committed TTF and do not require Node.js or network access. The font is
embedded as resource 101 and registered privately in memory, never installed.

UI glyphs: chat-square-text (F264, app logo), plus-lg (F64D), gear (F3E5), dash-lg (F63B), square (F584),
copy (F759), x-lg (F659), and layout-sidebar-inset (F45D, sidebar toggle).
